decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted   therewith (Flood Risk Assessment, Drawings: Left side elevation as proposed, Left elevation as existing, Rear elevation as proposed, Roof plan as proposed, Ground floor plan as proposed, Existing ground floor plan, Existing roof plan, Block plan, Location Plan received 04/03/11.Existing left side elevation, left side elevation proposed received 03/05/11.Existing right side elevation, right side elevation proposed received 13/06/11)and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a proposed single storey rear extension
